title: Ontology of Software Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2611.25196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software maintenance is often a long and costly phase of the software lifecycle, encompassing activities such as defect correction, adaptation, code improvement, and functionality enhancement. Conceptual inconsistencies and terminological variation continue to hinder effective communication among researchers and practitioners. To address this gap, this paper presents the Software Maintenance Top-Domain Ontology (SwMaintTDO), a high-domain ontology developed within a five-tier ontological architecture. This ontology was constructed using competency questions, ontological analysis of documented maintenance processes, artifacts, and resources, and alignment with established software engineering standards. SwMaintTDO provides a unified and extensible conceptual model for representing key maintenance processes, roles, resources, artifacts, goal purposes, and the transition of target modifiable and context entities from current to updated main

translated_abstract: 软件维护通常是软件生命周期中漫长且成本高昂的阶段，涵盖缺陷修复、适应性调整、代码改进和功能增强等活动。概念上的不一致性与术语的差异性持续阻碍着研究人员与从业者之间的有效沟通。为弥补这一差距，本文提出了软件维护顶层领域本体，这是一个在五层本体架构中开发的顶层领域本体。该本体的构建采用了能力问题方法、对已文档化维护过程、制品和资源的本体分析，并与既有软件工程标准保持对齐。SwMaintTDO提供了一个统一且可扩展的概念模型，用于表示关键的维护过程、角色、资源、制品、目标目的，以及目标可修改实体和上下文实体从当前状态向更新状态的转变。
tldr: 本文提出了基于五层本体架构构建的软件维护顶层领域本体SwMaintTDO，为软件维护领域提供了统一且可扩展的概念模型，以解决该领域长期存在的概念不一致和术语差异问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Software Maintenance Top-Domain Ontology (SwMaintTDO), built within a five-tier ontological architecture, providing a unified and extensible conceptual model to address the persistent conceptual inconsistencies and terminological variation in software maintenance.
